belay.3: The belay is on a ledge reached by hard face moves above the top of the crack in the corner.

belay.5: The rightward traverse ends at the foot of the summit tower, where the next pitch starts.
belay.6: The pitch ends at a belay ledge about two-thirds of the way up the summit tower, after the run-out face.
belay.7: The belay is in the notch on the ridge between the summit tower and the neighbouring pinnacle.
